author: Driftlet
description_zh: 屿族纸卡：倒数一个值得等待的日子（可换自定义背景图）
description_en: Isles paper card: count down to a day worth waiting for (custom background image optional)

settings.description_zh: 屿族栅格两档——切换即调整窗口到对应尺寸
settings.description_en: Two Isles grid tiers — switching resizes the window

settings.description_zh: 每条 = 日期 + 名称；自动倒数最近的一个，当天停留一天，过完自动跳到下一个
settings.description_en: Each entry = date + name; counts down the nearest, stays on the day itself, then moves to the next

settings.description_zh: 卡面右下角的目标日期
settings.description_en: The target date at the bottom-right

settings.description_zh: 一键应用整套配色（会覆盖下方颜色项）；「图片背景」= 白字 + 黑暗纱，配合自定义背景图使用
settings.description_en: Apply a whole color scheme at once (overrides the color settings below); Image background = white text + black scrim for custom background images

settings.description_zh: 纸卡模式的卡面背景色；透明度滑杆让卡面半透明
settings.description_en: Card background in paper mode; the opacity slider makes the card translucent

settings.description_zh: 卡面文字主色，副标与单位自动派生深浅
settings.description_en: Main text color; captions and units derive their shades automatically

settings.description_zh: 自定义图片卡的压底渐变颜色；透明度滑杆调浓度（拉到最左 = 关闭暗纱）
settings.description_en: Color of the dimming gradient on custom-image cards; use the opacity slider for strength (far left = scrim off)

settings.description_zh: 自定义图片卡背景的高斯模糊（0 = 不模糊），文字始终清晰
settings.description_en: Gaussian blur of the custom image background (0 = none); text always stays sharp
